description:
Columbina Hyposelenia is a playable Hydro character in Genshin Impact .

Known as the Moon Goddess of Nod-Krai , Kuutar to the Frostmoon Scions , and formerly The Damselette , Third of the Fatui Harbingers , she was born into an unkind world and cast into solitude from the moment of her creation. Once a wanderer of looping paths and fading memories, she found her identity through the bonds she formed and the quiet hopes she claimed as her own. Though she bears many names, to those closest to her she is Columbina Hyposelenia—and she prefers it that way.
role_summary: Columbina is an off-field DMG dealer who enables her teammates to trigger Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, and Lunar-Crystallize reactions, dealing various types of Lunar reaction damage. After casting her Elemental Skill , Columbina summons a Gravity Ripple. She can accumulate Gravity whenever nearby characters trigger Lunar reactions or deal Lunar reaction DMG. Once Gravity is accumulated to its limit, different types of Lunar reaction DMG will be dealt. After unleashing her Elemental Burst , Columbina will summon the Lunar Domain, granting different buffs for the Lunar reaction(s) triggered, and increasing the Lunar reaction damage dealt by all characters within the domain.

talents.name: Moondew Cascade
talents.description: Normal Attack Summons Moonlit Tides, performing up to 3 attacks that deal Hydro DMG . Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Hydro DMG after a short casting time. If you have at least 1 Verdant Dew Verdant Dew When party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party will receive such a resource. Your party will receive 1 Verdant Dew every 2.5s for 2.5s after triggering a Lunar-Bloom reaction. Your party can have up to 3 Verdant Dew. If you trigger another Lunar-Bloom reaction during this time, the duration of this effect will be reset. , Columbina's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Moondew Cleanse , which will not consume Stamina: Consume 1 Verdant Dew to deal 3 instances of AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Plunging Attack Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.

talents.name: Eternal Tides
talents.description: Awaken Moonbound Tides, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and summoning Gravity Ripple Gravity Ripple After unleashing Elemental Skill Eternal Tides, Columbina will summon Gravity Ripple . Gravity Ripple will follow the current active character on the field, while continuously dealing AoE Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents. Additionally, while Gravity Ripple is on the field, and nearby party members trigger Lunar reactions or inflict Lunar Reaction DMG, Columbina will gain the New Moon's Omen effect for 2s, continuously accumulating Gravity. 20 Gravity can be accumulated every 2s. You can have up to 60 Gravity, and it will be removed when the duration of Gravity Ripple ends. Once Gravity is accumulated to its limit, a special Gravity Interference will be triggered. Different effects will be triggered depending on the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina. If the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is: Lunar-Charged: Gravity Interference will deal a single instance of Electro AoE DMG . talents.name: Moonlight, Lent Unto You
talents.description: When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged , Bloom , or Hydro- Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into a Lunar-Charged , Lunar-Bloom , or Lunar-Crystallize reaction respectively. Lunar Reaction DMG inflicted by party members gain a Base DMG increase based on Columbina's Max HP . For every 1,000 points of Max HP, the Base DMG of Lunar reactions is increased by 0.2%, up to a maximum of 7%. Additionally, when Columbina is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
